illustrations.name: Tool Connector
illustrations.description: Seven marketing and data tools wired into a single stack. Dashed rails run from each logo into a central card, light pulses travel the rails on a 7.5s loop, and three stacked slabs fade up in turn as their pulses land — a picture of many sources collapsing into one destination.

illustrations.name: Modular Block
illustrations.description: An isometric cube with one corner block cut out and set down beside it. Hard-mitred edges, three flat greys for the three face orientations and nothing else on the page — for modularity, composability and missing-piece stories.

illustrations.name: GPU Infrastructure
illustrations.description: An isometric compute stack — three GPU units racked on a plinth inside a dashed footprint, vents and ports drawn on the front and flank, an olive status strip fading down the stack. For AI, GPU and developer-infrastructure pages that need a picture of the machine.
